verdict_reason: The contact section and row are correctly removed, with exact positive lists, but the first test's title still claims six headings.

todos.issue: The title says 'the hub groups its tasks under the six numbered group headings, with nothing after them', but after this change the assertions prove five headings (lines 16-22) and five task lists (line 26). The overview spec now says five. The stale title is also copied into overview/coverage.json:228 and journey-section-captions/coverage.json:182.
todos.fix: Must: the title says five numbered group headings, and every coverage link to the test carries the new title. One way: rename it to 'the hub groups its tasks under the five numbered group headings, with nothing after them' and update both coverage.json links.

todos.issue: Line 26, which this change edits, counts task lists with the CSS class selector 'ul.app-task-list'. Line 24 finds buttons with '.govuk-button-group .govuk-button' the same way. The Playwright guide says to avoid CSS class selectors.
todos.fix: Must: the section count and the button list are found by role or through an overview page-object accessor, not by CSS class. One way: add an overview accessor for the task lists, such as getByRole('list') inside the tasklist region, and a buttons accessor, then assert on those.
